newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta Stock exchange revises Monday index.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta Stock exchange revises Monday index.

text.p: The Jakarta Stock Exchange (JSE) said on Tuesday it had revised Monday's closing composite index following share adjustments of three listed companies.
JSE said the index was revised to 697.37 from 696.03 at the close on Monday, up 0.87 points instead of closing down 0.47 points. The index closed at 696.50 on Friday.
It said it had revised the index due to changes in weighting after a warrants conversion by PT Perdana Cipta Multi Persada and stock splits in PT Duta Pertiwi and PT Keramika Indonesia.
